answer: The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, capped per identity per epoch, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. The atlas of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. Every claim climbs the lotus of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the summit re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
